science.qualification: The shadow drawn as a black disc that always faces the viewer, sized from the EHT-measured angular gravitational radius. A display convention; not an event horizon, a surface or a measured color. No lighting. Around it, on the off-limb plate, the EHT 1.3 mm image of 2017 April 11: the eht-imaging pipeline of M87 Paper IV run once with its released fiducial parameters, on eht-imaging's own display color map (matplotlib afmhot, linear, sampled at quarter steps), a legend for relative intensity and not a color.

offLimbContext.source: observations/eht-2017-04-11-fiducial.fits: the EHT M87 Paper IV eht-imaging fiducial reconstruction, 2017 April 11
offLimbContext.composition: the image's light on the display stretch, alpha fading to zero light; the plate covers the image's 128 microarcsecond field at the shadow's scale (496 x 128 / 39.49)
offLimbContext.rotation: celestial north to its screen direction at the default camera

limbMaterial.composition: transparent: the sphere's own silhouette is the limb; the light just outside it is on the off-limb plate
